description: Cases for the Starter Template's custom lint rules (templates/starter/eslint.config.mjs). Each has a file name (rules apply by path), code, and the message fragments the lint must report, in order; an empty list means clean. orchestrator/test_starter_lint.py runs them. A new or tightened rule adds cases here.

cases.name: a test reads an application file (named import)
a test reads an application file (member call)
a test asserts on flags.json
cases.code: it("records the flag", () => { const entry = load("flags.json"); expect(entry).toBeTruthy(); });

cases.name: a frontend test file is covered too
a behaviour test is clean
cases.code: it("answers 200", async () => { const res = await get("/api/health"); expect(res.status).toBe(200); });

cases.name: application code may read files
cases.code:
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export const text = readFileSync("data.txt", "utf8");
